_about: Human-verified official pricing domains. Each key is a vendor domain; its values are other domains where that SAME vendor publishes its own prices. Subdomains of every entry count. A price is official only if its page is on the product vendor's own domains: being Tier 1 in sources.csv never makes a page official for a different vendor. Add a vendor only after checking that the domain belongs to it. Seeded from the pricing locations noted in sources.csv.
